source: r37 with r36 undeformed hook mesh
bark: Direct scanned diffuse with saturation .28 and value .78; discarded compounded ramp remaps; 7mm normal bump
measurement_method: Minimum closest point over all actual hook triangles to analytic uniform sphere, minus radius; terminal measured as sphere. Positive gap does not establish good projected silhouette.
hook_refinement: Uniform upper arc elevation with broad transition; source cap and terminal stay aligned; localized socket relaxation
